notes.claim: When two variables are directly proportional, they increase at the same rate, so doubling the first doubles the other.
A transformer's secondary voltage follows the turns ratio, so a 10 : 1 turns ratio gives a 10 : 1 voltage ratio.
It is a common misconception that all linear relationships are proportional.

sources.title: Transformer Basics and Transformer Principles, Electronics Tutorials
sources.quote: the turns ratio of any given transformer will be the same as its voltage ratio.

sources.title: Step-up and Step-down Transformers, All About Circuits
sources.quote: Turns ratio of 10:1 yields 10:1 primary:secondary voltage ratio and 1:10 primary:secondary current ratio.

sources.title: Core Concept 8.1 Working with direct and inverse proportion, NCETM

sources.title: Equations of direct and inverse proportion - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: When two variables are directly proportional to each other, they increase at the same rate. If the first is doubled, the other is also doubled.
